name: EPIC 211543524
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 12.3 solar radii and 1.28 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,400 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.28 solar masses and 12.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,542 K at its surface.
